With 16 boats in our fleet—from the cosy Dubhe (5 pax) to the palatial Ferretti 94 (12 pax)—you can explore the Costa del Sol’s coves without the August bustle. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA. Ready to book? Browse our fleet and contact us via WhatsApp.

Why October 2041 Is Perfect for a Puerto Banús Yacht Rental

October in Marbella delivers mild days (high 24°C) and cooler evenings (low 16°C), with average wind speeds of 15 knots—ideal for stable cruising. The sea stays warm enough for swimming, and the marina at Puerto Banús is far less crowded than in July or August. You’ll find more flexible booking slots and quieter anchorages along the Golden Mile. For a puerto banus yacht rental october 2041, this shoulder season offers the best balance of comfort and value.

Weather and Sea Conditions in October 2041

Expect about 6 rainy days in October, mostly brief showers. Sunshine averages 7 hours per day, and sunset is around 19:30, giving you long evenings for sunset cruises. Sea surface temperature is 21°C, and visibility underwater is excellent—great for snorkelling at Cala Cortés. Our skippers monitor conditions closely and can adjust routes to avoid any afternoon breezes. For a detailed forecast, check local marine weather before departure.

Best Routes and Destinations in October

In a 4-hour charter (e.g., Astondoa 40 at €749), head east to Cala del Faro (8 NM) or Cabopino (12 NM).
